Subscription Plans

The company offers three subscription plans: Basic, Pro, and Enterprise.

The Basic Plan is suitable for individual users.

The Pro Plan is designed for professionals and small businesses.

The Enterprise Plan is intended for large organizations requiring advanced features and support.

Customers may upgrade or downgrade their plans at any time.

Premium Features

Premium features include advanced analytics, AI-powered recommendations, priority support, and custom reporting.

Pro Plan users receive access to advanced analytics and priority support.

Enterprise Plan users receive all premium features along with dedicated account management.

Premium features are continuously updated based on customer feedback.

Access to premium features depends on the active subscription plan.

Contact Information

Customers can contact the company via email at support@companydemo.com.

Phone support is available at +1-800-555-1234 during business hours.

General inquiries can be submitted through the contact form on the website.

Enterprise customers are assigned dedicated account managers.

Support tickets can be tracked through the customer portal.
Contract Requirements

A valid contract requires:

1. Offer
2. Acceptance
3. Consideration
4. Legal Capacity
5. Lawful Purpose

Both parties must agree to the terms.

The contract should clearly define
rights and obligations.

Written contracts are recommended
for legal protection.
